faq.a: Walk-ins are welcome for hair, skin, nails and waxing. Makeup, including bridal and party makeup, needs to be pre-booked. Call your branch or send a booking request.
We have salons at I-8 Markaz and F-7 Markaz in Islamabad, and in Civil Line, Jhelum. Each branch page lists its address, phone number, opening hours and directions.
I-8 Markaz and Jhelum are open every day from 10:30 AM to 8:30 PM. F-7 Markaz is open 10:30 AM to 8 PM, and from 8:30 AM on Sundays. Hours can change on public holidays, so please call ahead.

faq.q: How much do your services cost?
faq.a: Prices depend on the service, hair length and the artist (for example, Signature or Senior Artist makeup). Call your branch for a quote, and ask about our Student and Working Ladies deals.
Yes. You can book a makeup trial and consultation to explore looks, tones and products before your event.
Professional brands including L'Oréal Professionnel, MAC, NARS, NYX, Dior, Janssen Cosmetics, Thalgo, Bremod and Xtenso.
